tables.name: dim_customers
tables.comment: One row per customer account, with default address and lifetime order stats. (dbt model gold.dim_customers, table)

columns.name: valid_orders_count
columns.comment: Orders that were not cancelled.

columns.name: lifetime_revenue
columns.comment: Sum of total_amount over non-cancelled orders.

tables.name: dim_items
tables.comment: Warehouse item master with lot rollups. (dbt model gold.dim_items, table)

columns.name: next_expiration_date
columns.comment: Earliest expiration date among non-expired lots.

tables.name: dim_products
tables.comment: Storefront products enriched with their category hierarchy. (dbt model gold.dim_products, table)

tables.name: dim_storage_locations
tables.comment: One row per storage bin with zone and warehouse attributes. (dbt model gold.dim_storage_locations, table)

tables.name: dim_suppliers
tables.comment: Supplier master with inbound shipment rollups. (dbt model gold.dim_suppliers, table)

tables.name: dim_warehouses
tables.comment: One row per warehouse with topology and capacity rollups. (dbt model gold.dim_warehouses, table)

columns.name: sellable_locations_count
columns.comment: Bins whose stock can be promised to customers (see slv_wh__storage_locations.is_sellable).

tables.name: fct_inbound_receipts
tables.comment: One row per inbound shipment line with receiving variance and arrival delay. (dbt model gold.fct_inbound_receipts, table)

columns.name: arrival_delay_minutes
columns.comment: Minutes between expected truck arrival and receiving finalization.

columns.name: receipt_fill_rate
columns.comment: received_qty / expected_qty.

columns.name: is_short_delivery
columns.comment: Completed shipment where less was received than expected.

tables.name: fct_inventory_snapshot
tables.comment: Current stock per bin and lot, with sellable quantity and replenishment flags. (dbt model gold.fct_inventory_snapshot, table)

columns.name: quantity_sellable
columns.comment: quantity_available when the bin is sellable, otherwise 0.

columns.name: item_total_sellable_qty
columns.comment: Sellable quantity for the item summed across all bins and warehouses.

columns.name: is_item_below_min_stock
columns.comment: item_total_sellable_qty is below the item's min_stock_level (reorder point).

columns.name: is_expiring_soon
columns.comment: Lot expires within 60 days.

tables.name: fct_order_fulfillment
tables.comment: E-shop orders matched to warehouse outbound orders on order_number = external_order_ref (full outer join), showing both lifecycle statuses side by side, lead times, and status inconsistencies. (dbt model gold.fct_order_fulfillment, table)

columns.name: fulfillment_key
columns.comment: E-shop order_number, or the warehouse outbound order number for warehouse-only orders.

columns.name: order_to_warehouse_hours
columns.comment: Hours from e-shop order placement to outbound order import in the warehouse.

columns.name: order_to_ship_hours
columns.comment: Hours from e-shop order placement to departure from the warehouse shipping dock.

columns.name: status_issue
columns.comment: Reason the e-shop and warehouse statuses disagree (NULL when consistent).

tables.name: fct_order_items
tables.comment: One row per order line, with historical vs current price. (dbt model gold.fct_order_items, table)

columns.name: price_change_since_order
columns.comment: current_list_price - unit_price paid at checkout.

tables.name: fct_orders
tables.comment: One row per order with item, shipping and payment totals. (dbt model gold.fct_orders, table)

columns.name: is_total_consistent
columns.comment: items_amount + shipping_cost equals the order header total_amount.

columns.name: paid_amount
columns.comment: Sum of completed payments.

columns.name: outstanding_amount
columns.comment: total_amount - paid_amount.

columns.name: latest_payment_status
columns.comment: Status of the most recently initiated payment attempt.

tables.name: fct_outbound_fulfillment
tables.comment: One row per outbound order line with allocation and pick performance. (dbt model gold.fct_outbound_fulfillment, table)

columns.name: fill_rate
columns.comment: picked_qty / requested_qty.

columns.name: hours_to_ship
columns.comment: Hours from outbound order import to departure from the shipping dock.

tables.name: fct_payments
tables.comment: One row per payment attempt. (dbt model gold.fct_payments, table)

columns.name: seconds_to_capture
columns.comment: Seconds between payment initiation and capture (NULL if never captured).

tables.name: fct_stock_movements
tables.comment: Stock movement ledger with SKU, bins and signed stock impact. (dbt model gold.fct_stock_movements, table)

columns.name: warehouse_id
columns.comment: Warehouse of the destination bin, or of the source bin for outbound and write-off movements.

columns.name: stock_impact_qty
columns.comment: Change to total on-hand stock: positive for inbound receipts and positive adjustments, negative for outbound picks and negative adjustments, 0 for internal moves (putaway, transfer, replenishment).

tables.name: mart_product_stock_reconciliation
tables.comment: Storefront products matched to warehouse items on SKU (full outer join), comparing storefront stock_quantity with the warehouse's sellable available quantity. (dbt model gold.mart_product_stock_reconciliation, table)

columns.name: warehouse_sellable_qty
columns.comment: On-hand minus allocated, counted only in sellable bins.

columns.name: stock_diff_qty
columns.comment: storefront_stock_qty - warehouse_sellable_qty (positive means the storefront promises more than is available).
